reflection: Volume-contrast factors keep helping in 2023 and 2025 and losing in 2022 and 2024, with both models helped. Range scaling plus QQQ volume-vs-move divergence gives the best pairs, 0.03-0.04 and 4/4 years, but the pair bonus over the sum is only about 0.005-0.009, just short of the 0.010 bar. Dollar-volume and MSFT variants did not add anything. 2024 is the regime where all of these lose (calm uptrend, low volatility). This round I will try making the signals regime-aware, for example by scaling against a longer-window baseline or conditioning on trend. I will also try a few volume-free ideas that use price structure.

lessons.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_range_scaled
lessons.lesson: Range scaling of the AAPL-vs-QQQ contrast overlapped with the NVDA range-scaled team member (similarity 0.49), so it added little on the team and still lost in 2022 and 2024.

lessons.name: qqq_volume_vs_move_divergence_60d
lessons.lesson: Using range with a 60d baseline weakened the divergence signal, and 2024 lost heavily (-0.044), so the slow window removed the useful short-term stress information.

lessons.name: aapl_dollar_volume_vs_qqq_dollar_volume
lessons.lesson: Dollar-volume z-scores mostly repeat the share-volume contrast (similarity 0.50 with the team factor), so they were regime-dependent and the pair gave no synergy.

lessons.name: aapl_range_vs_volume_efficiency
lessons.lesson: Subtracting volume z from range z gave a signal that is inverted relative to the useful volume-contrast factors and lacked any cross-asset reference, so it helped neither model.

lessons.name: aapl_nvda_volume_range_scaled_x_qqq_div
lessons.lesson: QQQ volume against absolute move size, scaled by QQQ's range, was the best single alone gain (+0.021) with big 2025 gains, but it lost in 2024, and its pairs help without a clear synergy bonus.

lessons.name: msft_volume_vs_aapl_volume_range_scaled
lessons.lesson: MSFT volume is too similar to Apple's own volume pattern, so the contrast carried no new information and hurt in 3 years.

factors.name: qqq_volume_move_divergence_range_scaled_60d_vol
factors.hypothesis: The parent failed in 2024, a calm regime, because its range scaling does not adapt to the regime. Using the QQQ range z-score as the move measure and 60d QQQ volatility as the scaler should boost the signal in stress periods and damp it in calm ones.

factors.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_surge_60d_base_trend_gated
factors.hypothesis: This parent lost in 2022 and 2024, the strongly trending years. I tried to gate it, but the formula collapses to zero except when QQQ sits exactly on its 60d mean, so the gate will not work as intended. The alternative is a smooth gating by 1/(1+|trend|), which needs division, so this is a coarse test of whether zeroing the signal in trends helps.

factors.name: aapl_close_location_vs_qqq_volume_weighted
factors.formula: safe_divide(subtract(multiply(2, AAPL_Close), add(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low)), subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low))
factors.hypothesis: Signed close location between -1 and +1 combined with intraday structure is different from the plain close position already tried. The hope is that the centered version gives a cleaner mean-reversion signal for the linear model.

factors.name: nvda_vs_qqq_volume_range_divergence
factors.hypothesis: NVDA attention relative to the market, scaled by NVDA's own range, may lead tech risk appetite and so Apple's next move. It is new because it uses NVDA's range for scaling.

factors.name: aapl_volume_range_scaled_vs_qqq_up_move
factors.hypothesis: This is an Apple-relative-volume partner scaled by the QQQ range, to match the parent's QQQ range scaling. The market-condition parent says what QQQ stress is, and this one says whether Apple's volume is out of line with it.

factors.name: aapl_range_share_of_qqq_range_x_volume_gap
factors.formula: multiply(safe_divide(safe_divide(subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low), AAPL_Close), add(safe_divide(subtract(QQQ_High, QQQ_Low), QQQ_Close), 0.002)), subtract(zscore(QQQ_Volume, 20), zscore(QQQ_Volume, 60)))
factors.hypothesis: The team factor is Apple-centric, and this adds the market state: Apple's range relative to QQQ's, weighted by whether QQQ volume is rising versus its slower baseline. It is meant to give interaction information that the team factor lacks.
